LIFECYCLE.applies_to: runtime ABI/version, creation, capabilities, errors and destruction
LIFECYCLE.oracle: Two live runtimes have nonzero distinct handles; destroying one does not change the other; invalid version preserves output; stale/double-destroy rejects; successful calls use real owner; exact V1 errors, callbacks, sizes and actual capacities require public-boundary tests.

DOC_HANDLE.applies_to: single document open/close/state and wrong/foreign/stale handles
DOC_HANDLE.oracle: Document and view are bound to their real owning runtime; invalid/foreign/stale handle and second active document reject without mutation; V1 state has truthful actual revision. Recovery and remote apply remain SDK-02 obligations.

VIEW_CAMERA.oracle: Create a valid view for its actual document; wrong or stale handles reject; camera reads match submitted state; use an independent numeric affine transform to compare world-to-screen and inverse, including invalid/zero scales.

INGRESS_ORDER.oracle: An accepted tool switch followed by down is processed in sequence against the explicit view; preserve actual input identity/cancel; bounds/invalid input reject without partial application. Native/IME physical evidence remains later.

TOOL_CONTROL.oracle: Use explicit typed mapping; queued admission is distinguished from final applied/rejected state; invalid enum leaves actual tool/brush unchanged; subsequent valid query matches control.

COMMAND_HISTORY.applies_to: typed command, undo/redo and batch boundaries
COMMAND_HISTORY.oracle: One accepted explicit user intent commits its supported typed operations and undoes/redoes once; separately submitted commands undo separately; invalid/stale precommit leaves canonical and history unchanged. D07 injected OOM hang remains separate unresolved evidence and is not relabeled.

SELECTION.applies_to: summary/selection IDs and added multi-selection API
SELECTION.oracle: Caller copies full IDs and revision-bound actual selection; too-small output is unchanged except required size; exact eligible/excluded, mixed/partial, permission, refusal, receipt and per-root leaf results must match independent fixture on real SDK and both actual hosts.

DEFERRED.oracle: A currently unimplemented function is not falsely reported as successful; if an exported compatibility entry exists, unsupported must be explicit and non-mutating. Deferral does not establish its future contract or override mandatory multi-selection consumer parity.

API01.sdk01_gate: Required: actual installed C/C++ consumers; header, exports and no private leak

API02.sdk01_gate: Required: sizes, versions, nulls, buffers, ownership and target ABI layout for SDK-01 types

API03.sdk01_gate: Required: real isolated Runtime/Document/View handle domains and full IDs

API04.sdk01_gate: Required: ordered controls, typed target, receipts, stale and supported ingress

API05.sdk01_gate: Required: selected supported edits, per-root preservation, History, actual Windows/Web multi-selection migration
API05.future_owner: SDK-01; D07 full OOM sweep remains independent

API06.sdk01_gate: Required: do not misrepresent submission as presentation; existing host stays functional during migration
API06.future_owner: SDK-03/04 full surface identity and actual presentation

API07.sdk01_gate: Required: SDK-01 handle/state only; unsupported deferred calls never claim success

API08.sdk01_gate: Required: deferred resource calls never claim success; preserve existing host behavior

API09.sdk01_gate: Required: SDK-01 supported pointer/wheel/key identity and order

API10.sdk01_gate: Required: no 128-bit ID truncation in first native and web consumer bridge

API11.sdk01_gate: Required: installed public header/library external smoke and no internal leakage
API11.future_owner: SDK-03/04/05 full movable distribution and assets

API12.sdk01_gate: Required: prohibit full-document serialization on each pointer event; instrument actual path
API12.future_owner: SDK-05 accepted quantitative budget and benchmark
